Notes:

I started this one almost exactly two months ago. And boy did I learn a lot when working on it. Every chapter was its own style, which forced me to invent new techniques. I've come out of this an order of magnitude better at cleaning and redrawing than when I started. I've also learned to love the airbrush tool. I think this represents about two to three hundred hours of work. I am full of nothing but gratitude for all my friends who helped me polish this to be the best it could be.

I'll call out chapter 8 as my favorite, and chapter 22 as the one that was most hellish to work on. Chapter 22 was like a solid week where I spent eight hours per day retouching the cleaning.

I almost didn't do chapter 6. It doesn't fit with the generally vanilla tone here, and I kind of hate it. (understatement. I hit it early, and almost gave up on the whole volume.)

Next will be something LAZY. Fuzukikai has another image set out featuring Seia, and that's nice and simple.
